title: Add phase-based product-design engine
goal: Replace the implementation-first frontend workflow with routed design phases, durable contracts, and a DTCG-compatible token scaffold.
notes: Merged through PR #2. External design skills remain externally installed; local skills define routing and contracts.

title: Streamline README product-design narrative
goal: Make the public README accurately and concisely explain the merged phase router, design authority, token architecture, and evidence loop.

title: Add controlled daily self-improvement loop
goal: Create a portable evidence-gated research loop that discovers ecosystem changes and proposes verified harness improvements without unsafe self-modification.
notes: Merged through PR #4. Daily Codex automation created separately; adoption and merge remain human-gated.

title: Preserve product-design resource links and notes
goal: Add a durable catalog containing the supplied design skill links, commands, phase routing, usage guidance, rationale, and assessments.
notes: Merged through PR #5. Canonical MotionSites source remains intentionally unverified rather than guessed.

title: Add deterministic project profile engine
goal: Resolve active capabilities from a machine-readable project manifest and provide non-destructive doctor and change-preview workflows.
notes: Merged through PR #6. Version one never installs or removes resources automatically.

title: Add launch-readiness foundation
goal: Make the starter easier to adopt and objectively verifiable through open-source governance, profile tests, guided initialization, generated design-token outputs, and executable evidence contracts.
notes: Merged through PR #7. Showcase application remains a separate follow-up so it can be reviewed as a real product outcome.

title: Build Agent Mission Control showcase
goal: Prove the harness through a distinctive, responsive AI-agent operations product with understandable execution state, human approval, interruption, recovery, durable artifacts, and independent running-product evidence.
notes: Merged through PR #8 with CI, policy, interaction, responsive, and accessibility gates passing.

title: Add guided project initializer
goal: Make profile selection obvious and reversible through plain-language guidance, safe presets, explicit active/inactive capability plans, and external setup guidance.
notes: Merged through PR #9. Selection remains manifest-only and inactive resources are not routed or required.

title: Add task execution launcher
goal: Turn task-ledger entries into reviewed branch or worktree plans with dependency, profile, ownership, agent-routing, and verification gates.
notes: Merged through PR #10. The launcher prepares workspaces only; it never implements, installs, merges, deploys, or bypasses explicit confirmation.

title: Prepare v0.1.0 release and launch package
goal: Turn the verified starter into a reproducible, human-gated public release candidate with clean-checkout validation, curated documentation, reviewed artifacts, and launch-ready material.
notes: Publishing remains an explicit maintainer action. The workflow prepares artifacts by default and creates a public release only when its publish input is deliberately enabled.
